predecessors.name: Principality of Polotsk
predecessors.text: the lands surrounding Vitebsk, inherited by Sviatoslav Vseslavich when Polotsk was divided in 1101 (the Vitebsk fief only, not the whole Polotsk-Vitebsk core Cliopatria draws)

successors.name: Principality of Polotsk
successors.text: Vitebsk, 'returned to Polotsk's rule' in 1195 after the princes marched against the prince of Smolensk (the Vitebsk fief only)

ledger.x: 1101: Vitebsk becomes a principality under Sviatoslav Vseslavich when Polotsk is divided.
1129: Mstislav of Kiev annexes Polotsk and its vassals, Vitebsk among them.
1132: Vitebsk's prince is invited to claim Polotsk and the Kievan hold lapses.
1165: the princes of Smolensk acquire Vitebsk.
1195: the princes march on Smolensk and Vitebsk returns to Polotsk.
1195: Vitebsk is again part of Polotsk.
The Principality of Vitebsk ends in Polotsk's; Cliopatria's Polotsk shape from 1202 contains all of Vitebsk's grid cells.

wars.name: Mstislav of Kiev's war on Polotsk
wars.outcome: Mstislav annexed Polotsk and its vassals, Vitebsk included, in 1129; Polotsk's people invited Vasilko to claim the principality in 1132.

wars.name: Smolensk's acquisition of Vitebsk
wars.outcome: Vitebsk was shortly acquired by the princes of Smolensk in 1165-1167; the submission 'was short-lived, and Vitebsk soon regained independence' (Briachislav from 1168).

wars.name: Smolensk's influence over Vitebsk
wars.outcome: Vitebsk fell under Smolensk's influence in 1186; in 1195 the princes marched against Smolensk's prince and Vitebsk returned to Polotsk's rule.

wars.name: Quarrel over Polotsk (1162)
wars.outcome: 'the princes of Vitebsk, Minsk and Drutsk began to quarrel over the control of Polotsk' in 1162; no territorial result on the page.

certainty.note: The pages give no frontier line; Vitebsk's borders with Polotsk, Minsk, Drutsk and Smolensk are approximate.
